speaker: narrator
text: Part five. Four cloudy days. And Bit *shut down*.

speaker: narrator
text: Jay carries Bit across the city. In the *rain*.

speaker: narrator
text: To the only lab still open. *Dr. Kai's*.

speaker: scientist
text: You copied a sea slug? With a *smoothie*?

speaker: heroGray
text: It's real! It lives on sunlight *for months*!

speaker: scientist
text: It keeps stolen chloroplasts. That part is *true*.

speaker: scientist
text: But a cousin slug was tested on *light alone*.

speaker: scientist
text: It couldn't grow. Light helps. It doesn't *replace food*.

speaker: heroGray
text: So we were never really *full*?

speaker: scientist
text: Bit's code switched off the feeling. Not the *need*.

speaker: narrator
text: Jay hasn't eaten real food in *nineteen days*.

speaker: narrator
text: Neither has *half the city*.

speaker: scientist
text: The cure is simple. One bowl of real *food*.

speaker: heroGray
text: Easy! Everybody just *eats*!

speaker: scientist
text: Jay. Nobody bought food for two weeks. Stores *closed*.

speaker: narrator
text: Empty shelves. Dark windows. Closed *kitchens*.

speaker: heroGray
text: Not every kitchen. I know *one*.

speaker: narrator
text: Jay runs to Rosa's Diner. The lights are *off*.

speaker: narrator
text: And on the door, a new sign. *For sale*.

speaker: narrator
text: Part six drops in two days.
